jp.title: 台風31号 明日29日には猛烈な勢力へ 31日に小笠原近海へ 11月も動向に注意
jp.description: 非常に強い台風31号(インファ)は、あす29日(木)には猛烈な勢力に発達する予想です。その後は北寄りに進路を変え、10月最終日には非常に強い勢力で小笠原近海へ進む見込みです。小笠原近海で台風の動きが遅くなる可能性があり、11月も台風の動向に注意が必要です。

jp.title: 関東 明日29日朝は東京都心などで今季1番の冷え込みに 内陸では氷点下の所も
jp.description: 今日28日は、東京地方で「木枯らし1号」が吹いたと気象庁から発表がありました。また、関東北部では初冠雪が観測されるなど、季節が進んでいます。明日29日朝は、東京都心などで今季1番の冷え込みになるでしょう。服装でうまく調節して、体調管理にご注意ください。

jp.title: 遼河はるひ、夫に言及「長男を育てている感じ」11歳年下の元プロサッカー選手
jp.description: ニュース｜　元宝塚歌劇団で俳優の遼河はるひ（50）が、27日放送のBSテレ東『和田明日香とゆる宅飲み』（火曜　後10：00）に出演。夫に言及した。　遼河は2019年に元Jリーガーの鈴木彩貴氏（39）と結婚した。番組では、同じ愛知県出身であることが紹介された。和田明日香（39）が「それ（同郷）つながりで結婚したんですか」と質問すると、遼河は「最初に会った時に知りました。地元が一緒だって」と答えた。和田と「多分同じ年ですよ」と明かした。

world.title: Prime Minister Abiy in Moscow to Attend Third Russia-Africa Summit
world.description:
Addis Ababa, October 28, 2026 (ENA)— Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed has arrived in Moscow, Russia, to attend the Third Russia–Africa Summit.
Upon his arrival, Prime Minister Abiy was received by senior Russian government officials and members of the diplomatic corps.
The visit comes as leaders and high-level delegations from across Africa gather in Moscow for the summit, aimed at advancing multilateral partnerships, economic cooperation, and strategic dialogue between Russia and African nations.
 
Diplomatic relations between Ethiopia and Russia span more than a century, rooted in historic solidarity, cultural links, and continued diplomatic coordination.
In recent years, bilateral cooperation between Addis Ababa and Moscow has expanded across key sectors, with bilateral trade turnover increasing substantially.
The two nations also continue to explore joint initiatives in civil nuclear energy technology and capacity building, alongside intensified coordination across global governance platforms following Ethiopia’s official accession as a full member of BRICS on January 1, 2024.
The Russia–Africa Summit serves as an institutional platform for high-level political, economic, and strategic engagement between Russia and African countries.
 
Launched in Sochi in October 2019, the inaugural summit established a structured mechanism for regular high-level dialogue.
This framework was further advanced during the Second Summit in St. Petersburg in July 2023, which focused on energy security, food supplies, and industrial cooperation.
 
The Third Russia–Africa Summit in Moscow brings together heads of state, government ministers, and representatives of international organizations, alongside the Russia–Africa Economic and Humanitarian Forum, to strengthen economic partnerships, expand trade, and advance long-term cooperation frameworks.
